open_actions.action: Choose defer-current-toolchain or coordinated TypeScript-7 migration.
required_evidence: declared peer compatibility for selected versions

open_actions.action: Regenerate lock and run npm ci without peer suppression under a recorded environment.
Run lint, TypeScript build, Jest and required checks.

closure_conditions: A new compatible frozen dependency set installs normally.
reopen_conditions: Complete npm logs identify a different cause.
A new head, lock, workflow or material environment appears.
Upstream tooling changes its declared support boundary.
rerun_rule: Any changed head or dependency set requires a new run or explicit comparison with this run.
supersession_rule: Future evidence may supersede attribution or decision only through versioned records; this run remains auditable.
